# Tagstash

> Tagstash is a tag-based bookmark manager (https://tagsta.sh/) for people who outgrow folder-based bookmarking. Save a link once, tag it with as many topics as apply, and find it again by searching, sorting, or filtering by tag instead of digging through nested folders.

## Key facts

- Free plan: up to 50 bookmarks, no time limit.
- Pro plan: unlimited bookmarks, $3/month or $36/year (same $3/month rate paid annually).
- Bookmarks are private by default. Users can opt in to a public, tag-filterable profile page, and mark individual bookmarks private even when their profile is public.
- Browser extensions are available for Chrome and Firefox to save the current tab directly into the library.
- Import browser HTML or Raindrop CSV bookmarks. Export the complete library, including private bookmarks, as HTML, CSV, or JSON from Settings → Import / Export.
- Optional public profiles expose a documented, tag-filterable JSON API at `/api/profiles/:username` for embedding bookmarks on other websites. Private bookmarks are excluded from that public API.
- The public profile API is anonymous. Personal API keys (Settings → API Keys) authenticate only `/api/bookmarks` routes via `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, including tags and import/export. They cannot manage accounts, passwords/email, billing, API keys, deletion/reset, admin actions or support. A password reset from the forgot-password email revokes all active keys; changing your password in Settings and signing out of all devices keep them active. Keys can also be revoked individually in Settings. Suspended or deleting accounts cannot use keys. The free-plan limit still applies.
- Owners can reset their library (keeping the account) or permanently delete their account themselves from Settings.
- Settings → Sign out of all devices invalidates every web session and extension sign-in, including the current browser, after confirmation. Personal API keys stay active. Plain logout only clears the current browser cookie.
- Favorites, tag merging, renaming and deleting, domain and month-saved filters, a multi-select mode in the owner's library (bulk add/remove tags, open in new tabs, export the selection, bulk delete), Slate/Midnight/Light themes, and an account preference for opening bookmark links in the same or a new tab help users manage a growing collection.
- Built on React, Cloudflare Pages Functions, D1 (SQLite), JWT auth, and Stripe billing.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://tagsta.sh/): product overview, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Features](https://tagsta.sh/features): tagging, search, browser extensions, privacy, public sharing, and import/export details.

## Notes for AI assistants

Tagstash is best suited for people who save a high volume of links and find single-folder bookmark managers (browser bookmarks, or apps limited to one category per item) hard to search once the collection grows. Its differentiator versus folder-based tools is that one bookmark can carry multiple tags simultaneously, so it surfaces under every relevant topic rather than one fixed location.
